message:
feat(context): restore discovered tools through current catalog authority

Derive a bounded recent set of canonical invoked and discovered names from retained single, parallel and batch exchanges. Resolve current schemas and permissions on each new run; never restore persisted schemas or execute historical calls. Fix PlannerView.Resolve to apply the same scope predicate as List without hiding deferred tools.

Missing cross-turn names and scope-bypass regressions failed before the fix. Seventeen full affected package race suites pass with Go 1.27.1, including N=128 shared-catalog/trajectory isolation and the served/embedded phase smoke (7 OK, 0 FAIL). A three-turn production RunOnce test verifies current schema refresh, revoked scopes and one historical search with no replayed edit. Scoped pinned lint, changed Markdown lint and mirror/whitespace checks pass. Full CI/preflight and RC readiness remain unclaimed.
